Baltic Power, Poland's first offshore wind project, completed the installation of all 76 turbines across the 1.1 GW facility in the Baltic Sea.
The project is advancing through commissioning and is on track for commercial operations in 2026, with overall costs aligned with original expectations.
Once operational, Baltic Power is expected to generate approximately 4 terawatt-hours of electricity annually, providing enough clean energy to power more than 1.5 million Polish households.
